## T04.1. Canonical sources and whole-document bindings

**Requirements:** MW-R17, MW-R18.  
**Acceptance:** A22, A23.

### Exact task files

- `crates/vestrace-domain/src/source/mod.rs`
- `crates/vestrace-application/src/source/ports.rs`
- `crates/vestrace-infrastructure/src/postgres/source_repository.rs`
- `migrations/0197_source_import_authority.sql`
- `crates/vestrace-infrastructure/tests/source_import_contract.rs`

### Interfaces, implementation, and required observations

**Interface:** Proposed SourceCollection/KnowledgeSource/SourceRevision/SourceImportOperation/
SourceImportItem follow chapter 02. Use existing typed-ID macros. SourceImportRepository
provides create_collection(ctx,CreateCollectionRequest,key), get_operation(ctx,id), and
closed-schema source listing/history. M02 creates MemorySourceBinding with manual_override=false,
exact origins, and item receipts; MW-05 adds resolution rather than inventing binding later.

Create scoped keys/FKs and immutable revisions with ordinary-material references. Identity
is collection + external UUID, not global hash. Through the shared writer record capture
Event, one Observation memory, and exact revision link. Do not auto-confirm facts or elevate
labels. Check supported policy and exact catalog/grant names on clean and populated databases.

A22/A23 plus A28 require distinct source identities, immutable payloads, and no authority
from imported instructions.

### Verification command

Run only after the target/fixture exists. Verify behavioral RED, then GREEN and every linked case under the [shared procedure](README.md#shared-task-procedure). These are not results of this documentation edition.

```bash
cargo test -p vestrace-infrastructure --test source_import_contract --locked
```


## T04.2. Protected snapshots and durable preview

**Requirements:** MW-R19, MW-R20.  
**Acceptance:** A24, A25.

### Exact task files

- `crates/vestrace-application/src/source/ports.rs`
- `crates/vestrace-application/src/source/import.rs`
- `crates/vestrace-infrastructure/src/postgres/source_payload_store.rs`
- `crates/vestrace-http/src/api/source_imports.rs`
- `crates/vestrace-infrastructure/tests/source_payload_lifecycle.rs`

### Interfaces, implementation, and required observations

**Interface:** Proposed SourcePayloadStore::stage(ctx,operation_id,item_id,bytes) returns
StagedPayloadRef; read(ctx,ref) returns a protected bounded buffer; retire(ctx,ref) returns
a lawful erasure outcome. References carry same-workspace ordinary material/intent identities
and readiness evidence, never arbitrary paths. SourceImportService::preview(ctx,request,key)
returns 201 only for a fully durable ImportPreview.

Bound/validate input, reserve operation/items and ordinary intents, then commit intent before
vault work. Prepare ciphertext outside SQL through the existing protocol. Recheck item bindings
and publish immutable PreviewReady only after all inputs are durable. Pre-preparation death
means needs_upload; retransmission retires the old reservation lawfully before a successor.
Never guess plaintext or trust client-fabricated hashes/receipts. Exact body/key returns the
winner; changed body returns 409. Read policy precedes source content disclosure.

A24/A25 verify exact staged bytes, both preparation/crash boundaries, and no plaintext fallback.

### Verification command

Run only after the target/fixture exists. Verify behavioral RED, then GREEN and every linked case under the [shared procedure](README.md#shared-task-procedure). These are not results of this documentation edition.

```bash
cargo test -p vestrace-infrastructure --test source_payload_lifecycle --locked -- --test-threads=1
cargo test -p vestrace-http --test source_import_api --locked
```


## T04.3. Local scanner and bounded parser

**Requirements:** MW-R21, MW-R22.  
**Acceptance:** A26, A27.

### Exact task files

- `crates/vestrace-cli/src/commands/source_scanner.rs`
- `crates/vestrace-cli/src/commands/sources.rs`
- `crates/vestrace-cli/src/main.rs`
- `crates/vestrace-cli/tests/source_scanner.rs`

### Interfaces, implementation, and required observations

**Interface:** Proposed local CLI:
`vestrace sources scan --root <explicit-root> --state-file <outside-root> --output <sealed-input>`.
Preview/apply/status use HTTP. ScannerManifest matches SourceDocument; keep UUID mappings
outside the input root. Input shape follows ImportPreviewRequest with .md/.txt or closed JSON.
The server accepts no source path/URL to read itself.

Open the explicit root and reject nonregular/symlink/reparse or ambiguous hard-link scope
according to the supported platform policy. Capture bytes once, validate UTF-8/BOM/limits,
and retain stable mapped IDs; do not reread at Apply. Reject absolute/dot-dot/drive/backslash
ambiguity and path collisions. Uncertain rename requires user mapping, not inode/time/hash guesses.
The server repeats decoded-size and duplicate-key checks. A complete scan must actually cover
its scope; interruption means partial with no Missing assertion.

A26/A27 cover Windows junctions/Linux symlinks/traversal and byte-versus-character limits.
Record tested platforms and refuse unsupported safe modes.

### Verification command

Run only after the target/fixture exists. Verify behavioral RED, then GREEN and every linked case under the [shared procedure](README.md#shared-task-procedure). These are not results of this documentation edition.



## T04.4. Production Apply handler and import UI

**Requirements:** MW-R23, MW-R24, MW-R25, MW-R26.  
**Acceptance:** A28, A29, A30, A31.

### Exact task files

- `crates/vestrace-application/src/source/import_handler.rs`
- `crates/vestrace-infrastructure/src/postgres/source_repository.rs`
- `crates/vestrace-cli/src/commands/worker.rs`
- `apps/console/src/routes/SourcesPage.tsx`
- `apps/console/src/routes/ImportPage.tsx`
- `crates/vestrace-cli/tests/source_import_worker.rs`

### Interfaces, implementation, and required observations

**Interface:** SourceImportApplyHandler implements existing OutboxHandler with topic
memory.source_import.apply. handle(ctx,message) reads durable operation/item authority,
not a client-supplied principal. SourceImportService::apply(ctx,id,ApplyImportRequest,key)
returns ImportOperation. A separately checked cancel command is completed in MW-05.
The handler participates in MemoryMutationRepository::apply_in and uses item receipts.

Lock collection/operation; check exact preview, selection, expiry, and current rights.
Atomically transition/enqueue through the registered topic, processing bounded items.
Each item reauthorizes the original actor, checks immutable inputs/base versions, and commits
source/memory/audit/outbox/receipt together. Business outcome is durable before the dispatcher's
separate acknowledgement. Replay converges. Show application separately from index_state;
unavailable embeddings do not erase pending obligations. Complete from durable results,
including partial failures, not unconditional success.

Run all A28–A31, including revoked-actor handling. Real worker --once and process-death replay
are required, not only direct service calls.

### Verification command

Run only after the target/fixture exists. Verify behavioral RED, then GREEN and every linked case under the [shared procedure](README.md#shared-task-procedure). These are not results of this documentation edition.
